purpose: Prevent a recently verified job from being treated as fully fresh when critical fields were only inferred or verified earlier.
hardLocationRule: Only ba-area or verified remote-ok may be recommended. Unknown or stale remote/location evidence fails closed.
evidenceRules: Store fieldVerifiedAt independently from job-level verifiedAt when enrichment is available.
A fresh job-level verifiedAt must not refresh fields that were not actually checked.
Canonical/direct-company evidence outranks search snippets and mirrors.
If location or remote evidence expires, never silently preserve remote-ok; quarantine until reverified.
Temporary source failure must not delete an existing LIVE record; it only prevents priority escalation.
